savings.empty_history: You haven't set anything aside yet.
savings.save_note: It does not leave your accounts: it stops counting as spendable.
savings.release_note: It does not leave your accounts: it counts as spendable again.

errors.exceeds_available: You can't set aside more than you have available: {limit}.
errors.exceeds_reserved: You can't make available more than you have set aside: {limit}.
errors.exceeds_unassigned_reserved: You can't make available more than you have unassigned: {limit}.
errors.exceeds_unassigned_reserved_pick: Unassigned has {limit}. To make more available, pick a purpose.
errors.exceeds_purpose_reserved: You can’t make available more than you have saved in {purpose}: {limit}.
errors.generic: We couldn't save the change. Please try again.

suggestion.title: Set some of it aside?
suggestion.body: You can set aside {amount} of this income. It doesn't leave your accounts.

savings.gap_note: Your bank will still show the full amount. Grana doesn't move your money: it marks how much you decided not to touch.

purposes.created_body: It is in your list now, still with no money. Do you want to assign some?
purposes.unallocate_note: Removing the purpose sends the money back to «Unassigned»: it stays set aside. To spend it, use «Make available».
purposes.none_explainer: Still set aside: it just needs a purpose.
purposes.label: What for
purposes.delete_with_money: You have {amounts} saved here. If you delete it, that money goes back to Unassigned. It isn’t lost or spent.

errors.duplicate: You already have a purpose called “{name}”.
errors.generic: We couldn’t save the purpose. Try again.
errors.exceeds_unassigned: You can’t assign more than you have unassigned: {limit}.
errors.exceeds_allocated: You can’t unassign more than you have assigned to {purpose}: {limit}.

purposes.allocate_note: This doesn’t move money or change what you can spend. It only says what part of your savings is for.

savings.module_support: Stays in your accounts, but does not count as spendable.
savings.bank_fold: Why your bank shows a different number
savings.empty_title: You haven't set anything aside yet
savings.empty_body: You can mark part of your money so it stops counting as available. It doesn't leave your bank: Grana just helps you keep it apart from day-to-day spending.
